title: donneesqc-mcp: open data for AI assistants

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if you could ask an AI assistant about Québec or Montréal public data and get real answers from the source?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds like it needs a bridge between the assistant and the data portals.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's this project. donneesqc-mcp is a fork that exposes open-data operations from Québec and Montréal as M C P tools, so an assistant can call them directly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The entry point registers the whole collection of tools and starts an HTTP transport. Then dataset access and geographic helpers live in their own separate modules, which keeps things tidy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And it's built to be reliable, I assume?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The page describes it as a production server with strict schema validation. It's almost entirely Python, tested with pytest, there's a Docker setup, and it's MIT licensed with the upstream credited.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The written page has the module layout.
